name: Diamond Dream
source:
A devil with a mischievous personality. Recently, he has set up a dubious religion and is playing around making fun of humans.

He's skillfully deceiving them, but he's actually a super dangerous demon.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/28682]official website[/url]]
